report_input.summary: The privileged state transition relies on tx.origin and can accept an intermediary contract call initiated by the owner.
report_input.technical_details: privilegedAction compares tx.origin with the stored owner. An intermediary remains msg.sender while preserving the owner's address as tx.origin, so the authorization boundary does not constrain the immediate caller.

The intermediary invokes privilegedAction on the pilot fixture.

Have the owner call the intermediary, which calls privilegedAction.
Observe that protectedCounter increments even though the intermediary is the immediate caller.
